I told Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-team on 14 Oct. Hollis is a member of that channel, so he can see it himself, and seat counts aren't finance figures.

Nobody in the channel has posted a different number since then. I also couldn't find any Marrow account files to check it against, so I told him to ask Tobias if he needs it confirmed.
